spec: INV-04. `working` and `amrap` count toward volume, PR detection, per-microcycle set counts and every progression decision; `warmup`, `drop` and `backoff` are recorded and excluded. A set also has to have been completed: a set_logs row exists from the moment a set is pre-filled from a routine, long before anyone lifts it, and counting an untouched row would inflate every total on the screen the user is reading mid-workout.
expectation_shape: `expected` is a boolean. The cases enumerate all five set types against both completion states, so adding a sixth type to the enum without deciding whether it counts fails here rather than in a chart.

cases.name: a completed amrap counts: taken to as many reps as possible is work by any reading
a completed warm-up does not: it is preparation, not work
a completed drop set does not
a completed back-off set does not
an unfinished working set does not count yet
an unfinished amrap does not count yet
an unfinished warm-up is doubly uncounted
an unfinished drop set is doubly uncounted
an unfinished back-off set is doubly uncounted
a deload working set still counts: INV-08 excludes deloads from PRs, not from totals
RIR left blank changes nothing here: tonnage is load times reps (INV-03)
a counted set may be missing its numbers and still be a set that was performed
